title: Market and competitor evidence
description: Comparable evidence for marketing and product decisions about a market.

sources.title: U.S. Small Business Administration, Plan your business: market research and competitive analysis

rules.instruction: Define the buyer, problem and geography before comparing alternatives. Include direct competitors and what buyers can do without purchasing a product.
rules.verification: Check that the comparison set matches the brief and explicitly describes how each alternative solves the same problem.

rules.instruction: For each market claim, record its source, date and market scope. Distinguish advertised features and prices from what customers reported in research.
rules.verification: Sample the decision-driving claims and reproduce them from the cited evidence. Mark missing details as unknown and record a validation step.
